The '''B-501 Field Survival Shrieker''' was a type of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
